_meta.note: Coarse, approximate coordinates for well-known public places around Chidambaram. Verify and refine before publishing; distances and walk times are deliberately not precomputed because they depend on where the user is sitting.

spots.name: Nataraja temple tank (Porthamarai Kulam)
spots.note: Water tank inside the Chidambaram Natarajar temple complex. Immediate, free, no booking. Egrets, pond-herons, swamphen, cormorants on and around the water.

spots.name: Temple outer streets and avenue trees
spots.note: Mature trees around the temple enclosure. Parakeet flocks at dusk, koel after dark, shikra over the street.

spots.name: Pichavaram mangrove boat point
spots.note: Roughly 15 km from Chidambaram; needs a boat, so it is a weekend trip not a micro-break. Winter migrants arrive Oct-Mar with the northeast monsoon.

spots.name: Vellar and Coleroon estuary edges
spots.note: Brackish channels bracketing the mangrove. Waders, kingfishers, darter. Best at low tide.

spots.name: Paddy fields west of town
spots.note: Open cultivation on the drier side of town. Paddyfield pipit, openbill, weaver colonies, lapwing.

spots.name: Annamalai road verge
spots.note: Scrub and roadside trees. Bee-eater colonies, drongo, roller, paradise-flycatcher.

spots.name: Any neighbourhood tank or reservoir
spots.note: Placeholder. Point this at a real pond near you and it will match herons, storks, kingfishers, jacana and darters.

spots.name: Neighbourhood park or garden
spots.note: Placeholder for flower beds and hedges. Sunbirds, bulbuls, white-eyes.
